name: Mindera (Centro Empresarial Mapfre)
short: The Porto office of the software company Mindera: the Mapfre business centre on Rua de Gonçalo Cristóvão, beside Trindade station. Mindera has worked in the city since 2014.
long: Mindera is a software engineering company. It opened its first Portuguese office in Porto in 2014. Today its Porto office is in the Centro Empresarial Mapfre at Rua de Gonçalo Cristóvão 347, beside Trindade station. The building of grey stone and blue glass turns its main front north, to the street.
history:
Mindera opened its first Portuguese office in Porto in 2014. Two more followed: Aveiro in 2018 and Coimbra in 2021. By the company's own account Portugal is its largest location, with more than 650 people, who choose between an office and remote work.

The company describes its Porto office in a few words: next to Trindade, in the Mapfre building, in the heart of downtown. The address on its site is Rua de Gonçalo Cristóvão 347, suite 404. Its teams also ran their own conference in the city, Type Off, held at the Alfândega do Porto.

The building itself is the Mapfre business centre. Its owner names the combination of glass and stone as the mark of the design. The centre has 83 offices, some with their own terraces. Under it lies a covered car park with 260 places on three levels, entered from Rua de Alferes Malheiro and Rua de Gonçalo Cristóvão.

The street front has three clear parts. On the left, three tall glazed bays stand between stone piers. On the right, a plain stone block carries the emblem and the name of the centre. Above them sits a blue glass block of the upper floors.

The model on this map follows the building's outline in OpenStreetMap and the owner's photographs. No height of the building is published: 30 metres is an estimate from the storeys seen in a photograph. The south wing cannot be seen from the street, so its height and its walls are an assumption in the model.
facts: Mindera opened its first Portuguese office in Porto in 2014.
The office address: Rua de Gonçalo Cristóvão 347, the Mapfre business centre.
Mindera has three offices in Portugal: Porto, Aveiro and Coimbra.
More than 650 people work for the company in Portugal.
The Mapfre business centre has 83 offices and a covered car park with 260 places.
The model's height, 30 metres, is an estimate: no figure is published.
tip: This is an office building, not a museum: entry is for business only. From outside, the front shows best from Rua de Gonçalo Cristóvão. Trindade metro station is next to it.
